I've been to a lot of escape rooms, and I know that they are stricter than other companies when it comes to changing reservations, but I think this is the first time I've been to a place where there is no such thing as this for an overseas schedule.
It's not 10,000 won or 20,000 won, and the basic unit price is higher than other industries, so I wonder if it's right to do business without any frills. I have worked at four escape room stores, but I have never had to deal with customers this tightly.

On December 30, 2025, 5 people visited and conducted a ‘Gap in Memory’ theme. After about 30 minutes and almost no progress due to difficulty issues, the fire alarm inside the store suddenly went off. After that, I couldn't move in the room for about 20 minutes, and eventually the desk person opened the door so I was able to give up. My cell phone had been turned in, but I couldn't contact the desk, and the door was locked so I couldn't get out on my own. There was no prior guidance on how to respond to an emergency situation, and I was so anxious that I actually called 112 using the standard cell phone provided. I received a full refund, but I was disappointed with the representative's response.
+ After coming out, it was explained that it was a malfunction of the fire alarm, but please think about how the person trapped in the room would react to the situation where the alarm continues to sound.

On the second day of my trip to Seoul, I went to the underground shopping center at Gangnam Station!
This is a huge shopping street directly connected to the subway station, and it has everything from fashion items to miscellaneous goods and even the smartphone case I was looking for. It's attractive that you can conveniently stop by while traveling.
In particular, there are a lot of smartphone case stores, and the designs are really rich, from the latest models to the ones from before. The price was very reasonable (Cospa's best!), so she and I were able to happily choose the case we liked.
What impressed me most was that the people in the store were very friendly. Even though we couldn't communicate perfectly, they responded diligently using gestures and translation apps, so I was able to shop happily.
